lossesPrevention.title: Losses & Prevention
lossesPrevention.description: Comprehensive guide to identifying, understanding, and mitigating both pre-harvest and post-harvest agricultural losses to maximize yield and profitability.
lossesPrevention.preHarvestDesc: Pre-harvest losses occur while the crop is actively growing in the field. They are divided into three primary drivers: Biotic (pests/pathogens), Abiotic (weather/soil), and Agronomic (management practices).
lossesPrevention.postHarvestDesc: Post-harvest loss (PHL) refers to the measurable reduction in both quantity (weight, volume) and quality (nutritional, commercial, or aesthetic value) of agricultural produce from the moment of harvest until consumption. Globally, approximately one-third of all food produced for human consumption is lost or wasted along supply chains.

krishiRakshak.safetyProtocol: Krishi Rakshak — CIB&RC & PPQS Official Safety Protocol
krishiRakshak.pesticideWarningHtml: Pesticides must never be used indiscriminately. Prioritize Integrated Pest Management (IPM: Cultural, Biological & Mechanical controls).
krishiRakshak.noVirusesDesc: Viruses have no chemical cure. Manage vectors only.
krishiRakshak.targetedActionDesc: Never spray insecticides for fungal rot, or fungicides for insects.
krishiRakshak.verifyDosageDesc: Strictly follow product labels and pre-harvest intervals (PHI).
krishiRakshak.selectCropTitle: Select Crop to Access Protection Guide
krishiRakshak.selectCropDesc: Choose from 25 crops to view verified pests, fungal/bacterial diseases, weeds, and IPM solutions.

sch_03.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
sch_03.description: Supports agricultural infrastructure and post-harvest activities such as storage, logistics and other value-chain infrastructure.
sch_03.subsidyBenefit: 3% Interest Subvention per annum up to ₹2 Crore

sch_04.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing (PMFME)
sch_04.description: Supports formalisation and development of micro food-processing enterprises. Useful for converting agricultural produce into value-added products.

sch_05.name: PM-KUSUM
sch_05.agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
sch_05.description: Supports agricultural solarisation, including standalone solar pumps and solarisation of eligible agricultural pumps.
sch_05.subsidyBenefit: Up to 60% subsidy on solar pumps

sch_06.name: MahaDBT Farmer Portal
sch_06.description: Provides access to multiple Maharashtra agriculture schemes, including micro-irrigation, farm mechanization, horticulture, and rainfed agriculture.
sch_06.subsidyBenefit: Various State Subsidies & Direct Benefit Transfers

sch_07.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
sch_07.description: A pan-India electronic agricultural market platform designed to connect agricultural markets and improve price discovery.
sch_07.subsidyBenefit: Market linkage and transparent price discovery

sch_08.name: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC)
sch_08.description: Works on farmer collectivisation and agribusiness development, including support related to Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs).
sch_08.eligibility: FPOs, farmer organisations and agribusiness ecosystem
sch_08.subsidyBenefit: Equity grant and credit guarantee for FPOs

sch_09.name: PMKSY — Per Drop More Crop
sch_09.description: Supports micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) and efficient use of water for agriculture.
sch_09.subsidyBenefit: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others

sch_10.name: Sub-Mission on Farm Mechanization
sch_10.description: Supports adoption of agricultural machinery and farm mechanization to improve productivity.
sch_10.subsidyBenefit: Financial assistance for purchasing tractors and implements

sch_11.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
sch_11.description: Promotes holistic growth of horticulture sector including planting, cold chain, and protected cultivation.
sch_11.subsidyBenefit: 35% to 50% subsidy for various horticulture projects

sch_12.name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Phalbaag Lagvad Yojana
sch_12.description: Focused on fruit-orchard development by providing 100% subsidy for planting fruit trees over 3 years.
sch_12.eligibility: Eligible Maharashtra farmers without MNREGA coverage for the same

sch_13.name: Rainfed Area Development Programme
sch_13.description: Supports development of agricultural systems in rainfed areas to increase productivity and minimize risks.
sch_13.subsidyBenefit: Support for Integrated Farming Systems (crops + livestock/horticulture)

sch_14.name: State Agriculture Mechanization Scheme
sch_14.description: Promotes the use of farm machinery and mechanization to improve agricultural productivity specifically in Maharashtra.
sch_14.subsidyBenefit: Financial assistance for farm implements and processing units

sch_15.name: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme
sch_15.description: Supports agricultural irrigation and water-management-related activities (farm ponds, lining, etc.) in Maharashtra.
sch_15.subsidyBenefit: Subsidy for farm ponds, micro-irrigation, and water management
